The plugin market
inside DeepSeek Harness

Browse and search 11979 community plugins, install with one click — most go live without even a restart. Updates, uninstall, live install progress. No telemetry, ever.

dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket
Then restart dsh web → Plugins → Plugin Market tab (dsh 0.2.1+; Settings → Plugin Market on older hosts). That's the whole setup.

This catalog is also a plugin market index. On dsh 0.2.1+, open Plugins → Discover → Index sources and add https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dsh-plugin-catalog/index.json — the list as a format-1 index, served from npm so it loads quickly everywhere (the GitHub Pages copies at awesome-dsh-plugin.com/index.json and dshmarket.com/index.json are the same document). The Discover tab and the plugin_market agent tool then search the same plugins.

  • Kingzhoudk/dsh-grill

    Per-conversation Grill switch in the composer tool row (also /grill on and /grill off): while it is on, the agent analyzes every request for ambiguity, missing information and contradictions, asks focused questions with 2-4 concrete options and a repair proposal, and plans or executes only after every blocking question is resolved. Trivial work is done directly with a one-line reading; non-trivial work is planned and stopped for approval. State is folded from the session log, so reload, resume and fork restore it, and a delegated subagent reports unresolved questions instead of asking.

    Multi-person personal chat rooms for DeepSeek Harness: you, the named agents you bring in, and another machine on your LAN can talk in one room. Members are bots with a name, a role and their own native session, so each agent keeps its own memory. Three speaking rules coexist as parallel switches: mention-triggered replies, a full round of every agent, and a chair agent that hands the turn onward; a shared speaker budget (max speakers per message, max hand-off depth) stops a roomful of agents from burning tokens. Rooms live on the host machine; another machine joins by address plus a six-character room code. When the turn belongs to an agent on the other machine, the host dispatches that turn there and the remote machine runs it in its own session, then returns the reply, so a person and the agent they carry stay together. Host and LAN members are labelled by origin everywhere (message rows, member list, floating window). What dsh-market is

🛒

Everything, in one place

The full curated catalog from awesome-dsh-plugin — categories, star counts, top/new sorting, bilingual descriptions.

⚡

Fast installs

npm tarballs are preferred over full-repo GitHub downloads whenever a plugin publishes to npm — typically seconds.

✨

No restart, mostly

Most plugins are live right after a page refresh. Updates and uninstalls take one click too — the market even updates itself.

🧩

Zero jargon

Missing a component? The market detects it and fixes it with one button. You never see a terminal.

🔒

Guard rails

Installs are restricted to the curated registry, build scripts stay blocked by default, and terminal-surface plugins are flagged before you install them.

🕊️

Private by default

The market never phones home. Even the bug-report log export is sanitized and stays on your machine until you share it.

Common questions

What is a plugin?

An extension that adds something to dsh: a different interface, another model, a new tool, access from your phone. Uninstall it any time.

How do I install one?

Install this market first (the command above), then press Install in the market. To install from a terminal, or when an install fails, see the install guide.

Does it cost anything?

The market and the list are free and open source (MIT). Plugins are published by their authors; check each plugin's own page for whether it charges.

Do I need to restart dsh?

Most plugins are live after a page reload; a few need one restart of dsh web. If the plugin shows up under Settings → Plugins, it installed.
